, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner response after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly identified "Anthony Asquith" as the primary director based on a misinterpretation of the search results. The search results clearly indicated that Willi Forst was the director of the original 1933 film "Leise flehen meine Lieder" (Gently My Songs Entreat), while Anthony Asquith directed a later British version titled "Unfinished Symphony". By prioritizing Anthony Asquith and ignoring the primary credit for the film in question, the Planner set the entire investigation on the wrong path, leading to the retrieval of London instead of Vienna. Although the Planner later corrected course to include both directors, this initial error was the root cause of the confusion and the wrong primary answer.
